regime_context: US thematic leadership is heavily concentrated in semiconductors/AI infrastructure with AI Infra ranked #1 (score 2.298, durability 0.72, breadth 0.917, not crowded). The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), but relative momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing has no forward edge, so all leans below are my own conditional judgment. Track record shows decent hit rate (0.679) but direction accuracy near coin-flip (0.488), so conviction stays low-to-medium.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed Cybersecurity handoff over AI Infrastructure: if CIBR closes its score gap to within 0.3 of AI Infra for 5 consecutive sessions AND cybersecurity's crowding_z drops below 1.0 (indicating breadth rather than narrow crowding is driving the move), I would retire the watch and flag a genuine rotation into Cybersecurity; until then the AI Infra lead remains intact.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infra is the dominant narrative with the highest score (2.298), strong breadth (0.917), eligible trend-gate, and not crowded (z=0.84). The validated edge here is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, not return forecasting, so this is a stay-with-the-leader, vol-aware lean rather than a momentum buy.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validated on this market's history
theses.dissent: As the clear leader with a two-standard-deviation gap to the #2 theme, AI Infra is the most likely to mean-revert or suffer a crowding-driven air pocket if the narrative stalls; its 'val_state: fading' tag suggests the freshness is already eroding.

falsifier.text: SMH loses its 50-day moving average and registers a drawdown larger than any prior 20-day window while breadth drops below 0.8 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the #2 theme and a confirmed challenger (score 1.647, margin 0.651 behind leader). Full breadth (1.0) and trend hurst support it as a cohesive runner-up, but crowding (z=1.95, crowded=true) caps this to a size-down cautious lean, never a fade.
evidence: crowded=true (z=1.95) as a sizing caution only
theses.dissent: Crowding z-score of 1.95 is among the highest in the universe; the AI Infra->Cybersecurity margin is wide (0.651) and absorption is low (0.31), so a challenger handoff is not confirmed and this could be a late-stage chase.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SMH over a 10-day window while its crowding_z stays above 1.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex (XLE) is one of the few non-tech eligible trends (rank 9, durability 0.67, trend hurst, breadth 0.591) and acts as a diversifier against the one-narrative AI concentration. The trend-gate is valid here, but this is a vol-control diversifier lean, not a call on energy fundamentals.
theses.dissent: Score near zero, breadth below 0.6, and an AI-dominant one-narrative structure suggest energy may continue drifting as capital stays glued to semiconductors.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own 50-day moving average while SMH does not, for a 10-day stretch, before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
